name: Fort Lee
title: Hudson River Paddling Conditions Near Fort Lee, NJ
blurb: Hazard's Ramp at the Ross Dock Picnic Area in Palisades Interstate Park, on the New Jersey shore right under the George Washington Bridge.

tide.label: NOAA 8518902 Dyckman Street
tide.note: Tide from NOAA station 8518902 at the Dyckman Street ferry slip, about two miles upriver across the river.
tide.cardNote: Unless you plan on landing on a beach or poking into a shallow creek, tide is likely not very important to you.
